name: melek-move-app
description: MELEK Move — Capacitor Android/iOS shell for move.melek.salon (adds OS step counting the browser can't do).
comment: webDir 'www' is a placeholder (the shell loads server.url=https://move.melek.salon). The OS step counter is the custom MelekSteps plugin in android/StepService.java; no third-party pedometer dep needed. iOS phase adds @capacitor/ios + a CMPedometer plugin.
